The Delhi government’s counsel has granted consent for criminal contempt proceedings against CJP leader Ratna Singh. The approval concerns posts targeting a Saket court judge that included the phrase “serving the master.”

Government consent is a legal prerequisite before criminal contempt proceedings can move forward in court. The report did not name the judge or provide the full text of the posts in question.

Ratna Singh is identified in the coverage as a CJP leader. The consent allows the contempt case to proceed, and the development was reported by Bar and Bench, Live Law, The Times of India, Mid-Day, and Hindustan Times.
